# jasnauskaite.lt — Inidė Jasnauskaitė-Jonaitė

Also known as: Inidė Jasnauskaitė, Inide Jasnauskaite, @jasnauskaite.

## About
Fashion, beauty and everyday life, unfiltered. Content creator based in Vilnius, Lithuania.
364K Instagram followers. 577M+ Instagram views. 133M+ TikTok views (counted separately).
788 branded posts across 156 brands. 8+ years of creating.
Collaborations via Reelize (https://reelize.lt) — we take on a limited number of projects each month.

## What I Do
Fashion, beauty, lifestyle and travel content for brands.
Instagram Reels, Stories, Posts and TikTok content.
Full production with Reelize: concept, filming, editing, post-production.

## Key Results
- 156 brand partners including Mionetto, Akropolis, Nissan, Hellmann's, Lancôme, McDonald's, Maxima, Milka
- 111 of 156 brands with two or more branded posts
- 5.9% engagement rate (feed only, stories excluded; platform average 1.9%)
- 788 branded posts — a new one every 3.7 days, on average
- Top organic reel: 37.2M views
- Mionetto — 30 posts, 17.2M total views, top reel 6.9M views
